notes.title: Update v1.2.8
notes.content:
Added music and sound effects controls options.
Added the ability to arbitrarily resize the game window.
Fixed a bug that occurred in the leaderboard when the Internet connection was disconnected.
Fixed bug with high volume of music.
Fixed screenshot bug.
